before.title: Sjögren disease
before.diseaseDescription: Bounded primary Sjögren disease: epithelial activation, interferon, BAFF/B-cell activity, autoantibodies, ectopic lymphoid organisation and glandular dysfunction; excludes secondary disease, mimics and symptomatic therapy efficacy. Cross-study synthesis; incomplete lacrimal, genetic, stromal and extraglandular coverage. No universal causal loop is asserted.
before.releaseNote: Agent source-checked local candidate; abstract access dominates. Contradictory AQP5 evidence and BAFF null comparisons retained. Scientific domain review and calibration pending.

after.label: Systemic disease activity
after.description: ESSDAI measured in selected treatment trials; improvement is not equivalent to reversal of gland damage.

after.text: Dazodalibep phase 2 improved day-169 ESSDAI versus placebo in the systemic-activity population (-6.3 versus -4.1; P=0.0167).
limitations: Mixed Sjögren population includes associated RA/SLE (21.6%); not a primary-only effect estimate.

after.text: Dazodalibep phase 2 improved the composite ESSPRI in the high-symptom/limited-systemic population (-1.8 versus -0.5; P=0.0002).
limitations: Composite dryness/fatigue/pain index is not a stand-alone dry-eye or dry-mouth efficacy estimate; 10.1% associated RA/SLE.

after.text: Dazodalibep antagonizes CD40 ligand and blocks costimulatory signals between T cells, B cells and antigen-presenting cells.
limitations: Primary trial mechanism description; the mapped B cell is an indirect cellular target, not the direct molecular target.

after.text: Ianalumab phase 2b met its model-based dose-response objective for ESSDAI at week 24.
limitations: 190 randomized; model-based dose response does not establish significance of the individual 300 mg comparison.

after.text: The 300 mg placebo-adjusted ESSDAI estimate was -1.92 points (95% CI -4.15 to 0.32; P=0.092), qualifying a simple efficacy claim.
limitations: Not statistically significant individual dose comparison; no universal symptom or salivary recovery claim.

after.text: Ianalumab is designed to deplete B cells and inhibit their activation and survival by blocking BAFF-R.
limitations: Sponsor mechanism statement; target engagement is distinct from demonstrated clinical benefit.

after.text: TRACTISS did not show a significant advantage of rituximab for its 48-week fatigue/oral-dryness primary endpoint (39.8% versus 36.8%; adjusted OR 1.13, 95% CI 0.50–2.55).
limitations: Anti-Ro-positive symptomatic primary Sjögren population; does not rule out effects in every organ or subgroup.

after.text: TRACTISS reported a significant improvement in unstimulated salivary flow despite its negative primary symptom result.
limitations: Secondary outcome; cannot substitute for the negative primary endpoint or establish global clinical efficacy.

after.mechanismOfAction: CD40L antagonism blocks T–B and antigen-presenting-cell costimulation; B cells are indirect targets.
after.indication: Systemic-activity or high-symptom Sjögren populations; phase 2 includes associated RA/SLE.
after.jurisdiction: United States; experimental Sjögren indication, no approved indication asserted
after.trialPhase: Phase III OASIZ 301 positive sponsor topline report September 2026; detailed phase III data not inspected
limitations: Phase III sponsor announcement is not a peer-reviewed complete report; no numerical phase III efficacy estimate added.

after.name: Ianalumab
after.mechanismOfAction: BAFF-R blockade and B-cell depletion; the direct molecular receptor is not a separate node in this map.
after.indication: Active primary Sjögren disease meeting trial thresholds; FDA Breakthrough designation is not approval.
after.jurisdiction: United States; experimental Sjögren indication, no approved indication asserted
after.trialPhase: Phase III development; efficacy claims here bind the peer-reviewed phase 2b trial
limitations: January 2026 sponsor report confirms development and designation; September 2026 Amgen report remains consistent with no approved disease-modifying therapy. No jurisdiction-wide regulatory database audit.
